name: Easy Sheet Pan Polenta "Lasagna" Bake with Ricotta, Basil & Caesar Salad

instructions.primary_message: Slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Arrange slices in a single layer on a large baking sheet pan with a rim (approximately 16 x 11 inches). Overlap the slices slightly if necessary, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (18 oz) tube polenta, pre-cooked
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spoon marinara sauce over the polenta, then sprinkle with shredded cheese, and top with dollops of ricotta.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (24 oz) jar marinara sauce
2 cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until polenta is warmed through and cheese is bubbly, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the polenta is almost done, place lettuce, dressing, and croutons from the salad kit in a large bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (19.4 oz) pkg Caesar chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Sprinkle over the polenta.
To serve, divide polenta bake and Caesar salad between plates. Enjoy!
